entries.purpose: The catalog API, album-guide-api on Fly (JJ's app): random starts, recommendations and search

entries.purpose: Album covers. coverartarchive.org redirects every image and JSON listing to archive.org and its numbered storage hosts (ia*.us.archive.org, dn*.ca.archive.org), which change per file
entries.data_sent: The release-group id in the image URL; no cookies, no referrer beyond the origin

entries.purpose: Popularity for an album added from MusicBrainz search (src/engine/ingest.ts)
